summary: Backend + frontend e2e testing of the customer asset funnel. 18/19 backend tests pass; full frontend funnel (register → dashboard, free claim → thank-you, paid checkout init, brand) verified visually. Two real bugs found: (1) admin login with documented credentials fails because the seeded admin doc is still the old bbedits.com user; (2) legacy 'PranavithDOP' (note: 'a' before 'v') typo still rendered on Home and About pages. One React setState-in-render warning on Login/Register.

critical.issue: Documented admin credentials (admin@pranvithdop.com / Admin123!) return 401. The DB still holds the legacy admin doc {email: 'admin@bbedits.com'} created on a previous run. seed_default_admin() in server.py only seeds when db.admins.count_documents({}) == 0, so the rebrand never propagated. Per the playbook, seed_admin must upsert/update the existing admin if the email or password from env changed.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Login/Register)'. Likely a navigate() or auth-context setState being called during render instead of inside a useEffect / submit handler. Functional flow still works but should be fixed.

issues: Legacy brand string 'PranavithDOP' (with extra 'a') still appears in body text — the global rebrand to 'PranvithDOP' missed at least the Home/About page CMS sections and the fallback site_name in /api/settings default response (server.py line ~412 still says 'PranavithDOP'). The seeded SETTINGS / PAGES content also likely contains 'PranavithDOP'.

action_items: Fix seed_default_admin in /app/backend/server.py to UPSERT the admin by env email and reset password if DEFAULT_ADMIN_EMAIL or DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD changed (or one-off-migrate the bbedits admin email).

Grep the codebase and DB seed content for 'PranavithDOP' (legacy typo) and replace with 'PranvithDOP'. Hot spots: /app/backend/seed_data.py (PAGES/SETTINGS sections) and /app/backend/server.py line ~412 fallback site_name.
Investigate setState-in-render warning in Login.jsx / Register.jsx — move navigate() out of render into a useEffect or the submit success handler.

Test request mentioned '/assets/bb-redesign' as a target slug — that slug does not exist (the 8 valid slugs are creative-lut-pack, premiere-pro-wedding-templates, cinematic-sound-fx-pack, after-effects-title-templates, royalty-free-music-bundle, smooth-transitions-pack, color-gradients-pack, typography-fonts-pack). /assets/bb-redesign correctly renders 'Asset not found'. No action — note for next agent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1200 lines; should be split into routers per resource for maintainability (>700 line threshold).

customer_auth.py reads RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET at import time (module level). If env is changed at runtime via supervisor restart the value updates correctly, but the empty-secret bypass should at minimum log loudly (currently it does, good).
MongoDB ObjectId `_id` is correctly excluded everywhere via {'_id': 0} projection — verified.

Webhook handler does not de-duplicate by razorpay_payment_id; replaying the same event will re-credit and re-write. Should check if order is already 'paid' before updating, or store an idempotency key on webhook_events.
test_credentials: Customer: registered fresh e2e-<ts>@pranvithdop.com / Test1234! per run. Existing: test@pranvithdop.com / Test1234! (login worked). Admin from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (admin@pranvithdop.com / Admin123!) DOES NOT work — DB has admin@bbedits.com.
seed_data_creation: Each test run registers a new throwaway user e2e-<ts>-<rand>@pranvithdop.com and creates a few orders + a free claim. No deletion performed (orders/users left in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_customer_funnel.py. 18/19 pass on first run; only TestAuth::test_admin_login fails due to stale bbedits admin doc. To re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_customer_funnel.py -v`. Frontend: routes /assets, /assets/<slug>, /register, /login, /dashboard, /thank-you/<slug>, /claim-free flow, paid checkout/init, webhook auto-credit all functioning end-to-end. The valid product slugs are the 8 in seed_data.ASSET_PRODUCTS — there is no 'bb-redesign' slug (that's a docs typo in the test request).
